title: Hugo E. Martinez
vital_facts: Born January 10, 1957 in Mayaguez, Puerto Rico
Married Nuria Merced Alvarez Pagan; Sealed in the Salt Lake Temple on Oct. 3, 1983; five children.
MD from University of Puerto Rico School of Medicine, 1981; Residency at University of Mississippi, 1984.
Bishop, Counselor to Stake President, District President, Counselor to Mission President; Area Seventy
President of Guatemala Guatemala City Central Mission
Second Quorum of the Seventy, 2014 - present
